name: Amazon

window.note: Most items, within 30 days of delivery.

outcome.note: You choose the refund method in the Online Returns Center; if the original payment can't be used, the refund goes to your Amazon account balance.

requirement.note: The official page says to return within 30 days through the Online Returns Center but doesn't say whether starting the return is enough or the item must also be shipped by then.

conditions.value: Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery through the Online Returns Center. Returns after the return-by date may be charged a late fee.

processing.value: Up to 30 days, depending on order type, return shipping, processing and payment method

categories.label: Opened collectible cards, board games and certain figurines
categories.note: A 100% restocking fee applies once opened, so nothing comes back.

categories.label: Apple-branded products (holiday season)
categories.note: Shorter holiday return-by date than other items; see holiday.

holiday.appliesTo: Most items, including Amazon retail, Fulfilled by Amazon and Fulfilled by Merchant orders. Return eligibility stays the same.

value.without: Returns are started from your Amazon account (Your Orders).

timing.value: Up to 30 days, depending on order type, return shipping, processing and payment method

fees.label: Late return
fees.amount: 20% of the item price for the first 30 days after the return-by date; 100% after that

fees.label: Opened collectibles
fees.appliesTo: Opened collectible cards, board games and certain figurines

fees.label: The UPS Store drop-off
fees.amount: Free; a $1 fee in a small number of cases when another free option is closer

methods.label: Drop off with a QR code, no box or label
steps: Open Your Orders in your Amazon account and choose Return items
Choose a drop-off location near you
Show the QR code at the drop-off; staff scan it and pack the item
methods.note: Only eligible items; look for the Free Returns badge.

marketplace.value: Items from third-party sellers that the seller ships go back to the seller, who chooses a US return address, a prepaid label, or a refund without a return. The seller usually refunds within two business days of receiving it. If the seller doesn't respond within 48 hours, you can ask for an A-to-z Guarantee refund.

unknowns.note: Not confirmed whether the item must be shipped by the return-by date or only the return started. Treat the return-by date as the day it must be on its way.
Amazon hasn't published 2026 holiday return dates yet. Past seasons extended returns to January 31.
No membership-based change to the return window found on the official pages.
The official category list wasn't confirmed in this check.

research: Official US pages read through web-search excerpts on 2026-10-11 (direct page downloads were blocked from the build environment). Spot-check before launch.
